title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add more atomic masses and a periodic-table helper
body:
## Problem
The built-in atomic-mass table has only 10 to 13 elements, so many common reactions cannot be used.

## Context
Session 2 and Session 3 use a small hand-typed table.

## Expected outcome
A table of at least 30 common elements with a source comment, and a check that every element in a formula is present.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 30 elements, standard abbreviated values
- [ ] A test that M(H2O) is still 18.015

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: reactions with many solutions
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. The Session 3 balancer reports nullity 2 but only returns a basis.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: titration calculator
body:
## Problem
Session 2 has molarity but no way to use a measured end point.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where titration volumes give a concentration with its spread.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-02/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Roadmap checkpoint value reproduced
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated balancer
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows atoms regrouping with mole and mass bars and a limiting-reagent chart; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Any balanced reaction animates with total mass constant in every frame
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
